title: 7.1 Angles of Polygons

icans: I can find the sum of the interior angle measures of a polygon.
I can use interior and exterior angle sums to find unknown angle measures.
I can find each interior and exterior angle of a regular polygon.

vocab: a segment that joins two _________________ vertices of a polygon
an angle formed by one side and the ____________ of the next side
a convex polygon that is both ______________ and equiangular

blocks.p: Polygon names (keep this list for the whole lesson)
Draw a convex quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon, and heptagon. From ONE vertex, draw every diagonal. Count the triangles.
Exterior angles. Draw a polygon, extend one side at each vertex, cut out the exterior angles, and put them together around a point. What do they make?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Polygon Interior Angles Theorem: The sum of the interior angle measures of a convex n-gon is _______________.
